meta.name: improve-codebase-architecture
meta.description: Scan a codebase for deepening opportunities, present them as a visual HTML report, then grill through whichever one you pick.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 扫描代码库发现架构改进点，生成可视化报告并逐项审查
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果希望系统化发现并改进代码库的架构问题
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to systematically find and fix architecture issues in your codebase

howto.what: Claude 会扫描你的代码库，找出架构上可以改进的地方（比如模块太浅、耦合太紧），生成一份带图表的 HTML 报告，然后针对你选中的问题，一步步引导你进行重构。
howto.when: 当你要求 Claude 分析代码库架构、寻找重构机会，或者提到代码库有“深度不足”“耦合”等问题时触发。

say.text: 帮我扫描这个代码库，找出架构上可以深化的模块。
say.note: Claude 会生成 HTML 报告并打开。

say.text: 分析一下最近改动频繁的区域，看看有没有重构机会。
say.note: Claude 会优先关注热点区域。

howto.what_en: Claude scans your codebase for architectural improvements (e.g., shallow modules, tight coupling), generates an HTML report with diagrams, and then guides you through refactoring the candidate you choose.
howto.when_en: Triggered when you ask Claude to analyze codebase architecture, find refactoring opportunities, or mention issues like "shallow modules" or "coupling."

say_en.text: Scan this codebase and find modules that could be deepened.
say_en.note: Claude will generate and open an HTML report.

say_en.text: Analyze the hot spots in recent commits for refactoring opportunities.
say_en.note: Claude focuses on frequently changed areas.
